quotations.old_english: Þá foregangendan hlǽfdian (praecedentes matres) gewunodon þ-bar; hí hit sǽdon þám gingrum nunnum, and nú þá gingran nunnan hit reccaþ

sub_senses.meaning: to take precedence of, rank higher than

quotations.old_english: Ðes Ióhannes wæs mára ðonne ǽnig óþer mon búton Críste . . . ealle þá apostolas and martyras hé foregongeð

source_text: fore-gangan. Add: (1) to precede (in time):--Þá foregangendan hlǽfdian (praecedentes matres) gewunodon þ-bar; hí hit sǽdon þám gingrum nunnum, and nú þá gingran nunnan hit reccaþ, Gr. D. 280, 26. Gódra foregangendra (praecedentium) wera, 8, 20: 277, 10. (2) to take precedence of, rank higher than:--Ðes Ióhannes wæs mára ðonne ǽnig óþer mon búton Críste . . . ealle þá apostolas and martyras hé foregongeð, Shrn. 95, 11. [Goth. faura-gaggan.]
